worldcombat.skill.dig.summary: Burrow under the surface and erupt at a chosen point, dealing Ground damage, flinging everything nearby and scarring the ground where it lands, which restores itself. The ground material sets the eruption's reach, the launch and the bonus damage.
worldcombat.skill.dig.description.0: The eruption deals %1$s physical damage, falling with distance to about half at the rim.
worldcombat.skill.dig.description.1: Eruption radius %1$s blocks; heavier casters displace more earth.
worldcombat.skill.dig.description.2: The caster erupts %1$s ticks after diving; higher Speed shortens the wait.
worldcombat.skill.dig.description.3: The impact point is locked when the dig begins: a target that keeps moving during the preparation walks out. The ground material decides the eruption: soft soil, sand and gravel give a wider, higher-launching burst; stone gives a smaller but harder hit; water or open air barely erupts at all.
worldcombat.skill.dig.description.4: Ambush is on: a longer preparation and cooldown for a wider, stronger eruption and a higher launch.
worldcombat.skill.dig.description.5: Ambush is off: a shorter preparation and cooldown at base eruption size and launch.
worldcombat.skill.dig.description.6: The eruption scars the ground where it lands: it swaps that layer of natural surface for coarse dirt or rubble, and the mark is real during the fight before restoring itself; it drops nothing and leaves ores, building blocks and containers alone. Water or open air leaves no mark.
worldcombat.skill.dig.timing: Prepare %1$s s, recover %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.dig.growth.0: From level 25 the eruption power climbs another step with level.
worldcombat.skill.dig.growth.1: From level 50 the eruption power climbs one more step.
On: spend 6 more ticks preparing for a wider, stronger eruption and a higher launch on a longer cooldown. Off: a faster cast on a shorter cooldown at base eruption size.
worldcombat.skill.dig.preference.ai.open: Only on held targets keeps the dig for rooted, paralysed or non-fleeing foes; digging at a runner usually misses.
worldcombat.skill.dig.preference.ai.crow: Only dig when at least this many enemies cluster near the target; 1 digs at a lone target.
worldcombat.skill.dig.preference.ai.maxC: Only consider digging when the target is within this distance.
